shots.what_it_taught: The request names no organism the tool can read, and the tool now says so instead of building an animal. "Bacterium" is not a taxon word in this repository; a scientific name is the way in.

A scientific name now resolves, the clade table reaches bacteria, and a declared parameter set resolves a STATE, so a prokaryote gets all the way into the studio, the law check and organism_get. What it finds there is that the anatomy ontologies, the cell ontology and the law set are all animal artefacts. The pipeline is clade-general; its contents are not.

IMPOSSIBLE, by a theorem rather than a simulation. At Re of order 1e-5 a time-reversible stroke returns the body exactly where it began, so the paddle design does not move slowly: it does not move. This is a verdict no shape-only layer could ever have reached, because nothing is wrong with the paddle as a structure.

The theorem no longer binds it and the declared cycle is consistent with the declared speed. That is NOT a finding that it swims: there is no motor model, no torque, no energy budget and no control here. It is the absence of a contradiction, which is the most this layer is able to offer.

On the designer's own four numbers the strain cannot invade when rare: at the resident guild's carrying capacity its per-capita growth rate is negative, so it is excluded. That outcome is a property of those four numbers and not a measurement of anything, and the run says so twice.
